Add_Budget: Holds a development phase's spending plan, approved amounts and overall cost position. Budget Category and Budget Item provide the detail, while Budget Approvals, Budget Modification and Budget Months support approvals, changes and monthly cash flow.
Builder: Maintains the builders and other counterparties involved in land purchases and lot sales. Add Contract, Add Builder Takedown, Add Forecast and LOI Worksheet use these records to identify the party involved.
Builder_Takedown: Records a builder's purchase of a group of lots, including price, interest, taxes and additional charges. It brings together Add Lots, Add Contract and Add Subdivision, with extra charges held in Additional Items.
Company: Maintains the legal companies that own or purchase land and development assets. Add Property, Add Project and Add Subdivision identify the relevant company, while Property Transfer records movements between companies.
Contract: Holds the main record for a Legal contract or Construction request, including its owners, status and related development. Contract Actions, Contract Approvals, Contract Pricing, Redline Review and Attachment hold its supporting work and documents; Parent Contract connects related agreements.
Equipment: Maintains each piece of equipment, including its purchase details, status and current meter hours. Equipment Usage Year and Equipment Maintenance Cost hold its annual usage and maintenance history.
Forecast: Holds one month's forecasted, scheduled and actual lot sales for a builder and subdivision. Add Forecast Year groups these monthly records into the annual forecast.
Forecast_Year: Organizes a builder's annual lot-sales forecast for a subdivision, including notes and annual totals. Its monthly detail is held in Add Forecast, with links to the surrounding years for context.
Lots: Tracks each individual lot, its location, buyer, status, pricing and sale information. It connects Add Subdivision to Add Contract, Add Takedown Schedule and Add Builder Takedown so the same lot can be followed from planning through closing.
Add_Pro_Forma: Holds the financial model used to assess a proposed land-development deal, including costs, sales, timing and returns. Proforma Phase, Proforma Months, Land Installments, Lot Mix Row and Proforma Item provide the detail; LOI Worksheet and Add Contract support the acquisition process.
Project: Groups related properties and development phases under one project, with its company, territory and status. Add Property and Add Subdivision connect the land and phases, and Add Pro Forma can link the project to its financial model.
Property: Maintains the land record, including acreage, ownership, acquisition details and legal description. It links Add Company, Add Project and Add Subdivision, while Property Transfer records subsequent changes between companies.
Subdivision: Represents a development phase within a project, including its companies, builders, land and key quantities. It connects Add Project and Add Property to budgets, lots, forecasts, Milestones and external project codes.
Takedown_Schedule: Tracks a builder's contractual obligation to purchase lots over time, including closing dates and lot quantities. It connects Add Contract, Add Builder and Add Subdivision, with Add Lots showing the individual lots assigned to the schedule.
Takedown_Template: Stores reusable tax, interest and fee settings for a builder's lot purchases in a subdivision. Add Builder Takedown uses this setup, with optional extra charges supplied by Additional Items.
Tax_Parcel_Year: Holds a property's tax position for one year, including valuations, protest dates, arbitration and taxes due. It connects Add Property and Add Subdivision to Add Taxing Jurisdiction and Add Tax Rate.
Tax_Rate: Stores an individual tax rate for a taxing authority and tax year. Add Taxing Jurisdiction identifies the authority, and Add Tax Parcel Year and Tax Rate Template use the rate in tax calculations.
Taxing_Jurisdiction: Maintains a taxing authority's name, year and contact information. Its Add Tax Rate records provide the rates applied to Add Tax Parcel Year records.
Additional_Items: Holds extra charges with an amount, quantity and total. A charge can belong to Add Subdivision, Add Builder Takedown or Add Takedown Template so it appears in the appropriate development or closing calculation.
Approval_Config_Audit: Keeps a history of changes to approval settings, including who made the change, its outcome and the before-and-after details. It supports review of Approval Policy and role-assignment changes and identifies the person through User Access.
Approval_Config_Lock: Temporarily reserves the approval settings while a change is being processed, preventing conflicting updates. It supports safe changes to Approval Policy and Approval Role Assignment.
Approval_Policy: Defines which approval steps apply to a workflow, territory or department, including how self-approval and repeated approvers are handled. Approval Role Assignment supplies the people, and Approval Route Snapshot preserves the route selected for a submission.
Approval_Role: Defines a reusable approval role that can be assigned to people. Approval Role Assignment connects the role to User Access and the relevant territory or department.
Approval_Role_Assignment: Assigns a person to an approval role for a territory or department. It joins Approval Role and User Access so Approval Policy can resolve the appropriate approvers.
Approval_Route_Snapshot: Preserves the approval route chosen when a record is submitted, along with its progress. It records the applicable Approval Policy and the submitted record's identity so later policy changes do not rewrite that submission's route.
Attachment: Stores a supporting file and the business record it belongs to. It can link to Add Contract, Add Budget or Add Pro Forma, with optional Payment Request or Budget Modification links for request-specific files.
Budget_Approvals: Records an individual approver's decision, notes and response dates. It links the decision to Add Budget, Add Pro Forma or Budget Modification and preserves the order of the approval steps.
Budget_Category: Groups related budget costs by category and department and summarizes their totals. It belongs to Add Budget and contains the underlying Budget Item records.
Budget_Import_Item: Stages cost and progress information received from external systems before it is assigned to the correct budget line. Its Budget Item link connects the imported amount to the budget, while status and error fields show whether the import succeeded.
Budget_Item: Holds an individual budget cost line, including planned amounts, actual costs, completion and remaining cost. It belongs to Add Budget and Budget Category and can connect to Add Pro Forma; Budget Modification and Payment Request refer to the affected line.
Budget_Modification: Records a proposed or approved change to a budget, including its amount, reason and effective date. It identifies the affected Add Budget, Budget Category or Budget Item and can have Budget Approvals and Attachment records.
Budget_Months: Breaks a development budget into monthly cost, revenue and cash-flow amounts. Each record belongs to Add Budget and Add Subdivision and supports the budget's timing and financing view.
Comment_Log: Keeps comments and their authors against the relevant business record, including edit or deletion status. Comments can belong to Add Budget, Add Project, Add Pro Forma or Add Contract.
Construction_Curve: Defines how construction spending is spread across the months of a job. A curve can belong to Add Pro Forma or serve as a reusable template in Settings.
Contract_Actions: Tracks the tasks, responsible person, dates and status needed to advance a Legal contract or Construction request. Each action belongs to Add Contract; template actions provide reusable starting checklists.
Contract_Approvals: Tracks an individual contract approver's sequence, response, rejection reason and reminder dates. Each decision belongs to Add Contract, and reusable approval rows can also be selected through Settings.
Contract_Pricing: Stores a contract's lot pricing by lot size, including price per foot, base price and escalation. These rows belong to Add Contract and support the pricing applied to its lots.
Contracts_Management_Search: Holds the choices used to filter contract listings, such as subdivision, builder, status and type. Add Subdivision and Add Builder provide the linked search choices for Add Contract records.
Equipment_Maintenance_Cost: Records a dated maintenance expense and its cost-code detail for a piece of equipment. Each entry belongs to Add Equipment and contributes to its maintenance history.
Equipment_Usage_Year: Records the hours used by a piece of equipment in a particular year. Each entry belongs to Add Equipment and provides its annual usage history.
External_System_Mapping: Connects a Land Master subdivision to its code in another system, such as accounting or construction operations. Add Subdivision is the shared reference, allowing imports and integrations to place information against the correct development phase.
Forecast_Search: Holds the choices used to filter lot-sales forecasts by subdivision, builder, year, territory or status. Add Subdivision and Add Builder supply the linked choices for Add Forecast Year and Add Forecast listings.
Land_Installments: Schedules a land purchase payment, land sale receipt or PID/MUD amount within a financial model. Each installment links to Add Pro Forma and supplies its amount and timing for the cash-flow forecast.
LOI_Worksheet: Holds the terms and versions of a letter of intent, including price, earnest money, feasibility and closing dates. It connects Add Pro Forma and Add Contract with the related Add Company, Add Builder and Add Property records.
Lot_Mix_Row: Defines one group of lots in a financial model, with its lot count, frontage and price per foot. The rows belong to Add Pro Forma and support its mix of lot sizes and sales values.
Lot_Search: Holds the choices used to find lots by subdivision, buyer, status, location, price or date. Add Subdivision and Add Builder supply the linked choices used to filter Add Lots.
Mass_Create_Forecasts: Collects the subdivisions, builders and years for creating several forecasts together. It uses Add Subdivision and Add Builder to establish the scope of the resulting annual and monthly forecast records.
Mass_Create_Lots: Collects the information needed to create a range of lots together, including subdivision, block, lot numbers and starting prices. Mass Create Lots Subform holds additional ranges, and the results become Add Lots records.
Mass_Create_Lots_Subform: Holds an individual block and lot-number range entered in Mass Create Lots, with optional builder and pricing details. These rows supply the detail used to create the corresponding Add Lots records.
Mass_Create_Tax: Collects the year, property or subdivision, lots and tax settings for creating parcel-year tax records together. It uses Add Taxing Jurisdiction, Add Tax Rate and Tax Rate Template to prepare Add Tax Parcel Year records.
Mass_Create_Tax_Rates: Collects several tax-rate names and percentages for one taxing authority. It uses Add Taxing Jurisdiction to create the corresponding Add Tax Rate records.
Mass_Update_Lots: Collects shared changes to buyer, pricing, lot size, escalation or fees for a selected group of lots. It applies those choices to the selected Add Lots records, using Add Builder for the buyer.
Mass_Update_Tax: Collects shared valuation, status, date and rate changes for a selected group of parcel-year records. It connects the selected Add Tax Parcel Year records with Add Taxing Jurisdiction, Add Tax Rate and Tax Rate Template.
Milestones: Stores the named milestones, dates and sequence for a development phase. Each record belongs to Add Subdivision and carries the external project and milestone identities used by the schedule integration.
Payment_Request: Holds a purchase order, check request or wire request against a development budget, including vendor, amount and status. It connects Add Budget, Budget Item, Vendors and accounting codes; PO Item holds purchase-order lines, while Budget Modification, Budget Approvals and Attachment support related changes, decisions and files.
PO_Currency_Probe: Provides an internal test record for checking how currency amounts are stored. It supports verification of purchase-order calculations used by Payment Request and PO Item.
PO_Item: Holds one purchase-order line, including the budget item, quantity, unit price and final amount. The line belongs to Payment Request and links its cost to Budget Item, with revision information preserving the intended purchase-order version.
PO_Operation: Records the request, starting position, status and outcome of a purchase-order operation. It connects Payment Request, Add Budget and User Access so interrupted or uncertain changes can be reviewed safely.
PO_Phase_Lock: Temporarily reserves a development phase while a purchase-order change or decision is processed. It identifies the responsible person through User Access and supports consistent Payment Request and budget commitments.
Proforma_AI_Review: Preserves an automated review of a financial model, including the version of the review criteria, score, findings and questions. Each review belongs to Add Pro Forma and retains the deal information reviewed at that time.
Proforma_Item: Holds an additional construction or development cost in a financial model, including how and when it applies. These rows belong to Add Pro Forma and can also serve as reusable cost templates.
Proforma_Months: Holds the monthly financial results of a pro forma, including sales, costs, interest and cash flow. Each record belongs to Add Pro Forma and reflects the timing established by Proforma Phase and the model's other supporting records.
Proforma_Phase: Defines a phase of a pro forma, including lots, acreage, engineering, construction and lot-sale timing. These rows belong to Add Pro Forma and determine how the activity appears in Proforma Months.
Property_Transfer: Records a transfer of all or part of a property between companies, including its date, amount and status. It connects Add Property with the outgoing and incoming Add Company records and preserves the transfer history.
Redline_Review: Records dated notes about changes or issues in a contract document. Each review belongs to Add Contract and keeps the discussion with the agreement being reviewed.
Settings: Holds shared application defaults, reminder settings, notification recipients and review criteria. It also references reusable Contract Actions, Contract Approvals and Construction Cost Curve records used when preparing new work.
System_Search: Holds the choices used to search the land and project records by company, project, subdivision or location. Add Company, Add Project and Add Subdivision provide the linked search choices.
Tax_Parcel_Search: Holds the choices used to find tax parcel-year records by year, status, taxing authority, location or related land. It draws on Add Property, Add Project, Add Subdivision, Add Lots, Add Taxing Jurisdiction and Add Tax Rate to filter Add Tax Parcel Year.
Tax_Rate_Template: Groups a reusable set of tax rates for a location and tax year. It connects Add Taxing Jurisdiction and Add Tax Rate so the same rate package can be applied consistently to parcel-year records.
Tax_Table_Search: Holds the choices used to find taxing authorities and rates by name, year or county. Add Taxing Jurisdiction provides the linked authority choice for the tax tables.
Territory: Defines a business territory and its designated vice president and development managers. User Access identifies those people so approval routing can select the appropriate leadership for the territory.
User_Access: Defines each person's application permissions, display name, approval email and saved assignment preferences. Ownership and approver links throughout budgets, pro formas, contracts, territories and approval roles refer to these records.
Vendors: Maintains the vendor directory, including legal and payee names, contact details, payment terms and hold status. Payment Request uses the selected vendor when preparing purchase orders, check requests and wire requests.
Workflow_Run_Log: Records the outcome of automated jobs and data integrations, including timing, processed rows and failures. It supports operational review across the application and tracks whether a failure notification was sent.
Crew: Maintains the named work crews and their display colors and active status. Employees records hold staffing assignments, while Crew Assignment places crews on development phases by date.
Crew_Assignment: Records which crew is assigned to a development phase on a particular date. It connects Crew and Add Subdivision and preserves the source identity used to keep imported assignments consistent.
Crew_Schedule_Lock: Temporarily reserves a development phase while a schedule change is processed. It links to Add Subdivision and supports coordinated updates to crew assignments and schedule dates.
Crew_Test_Record: Identifies controlled test records used to verify the crew and scheduling feature. It links the test to Add Subdivision and records the originating operation so the test activity can be traced.
Crew_Timecards: Holds imported daily timecard information, including foreman, job and work date. Its Add Subdivision link connects recorded field activity to the development phase and supports the crew-location view.
Employees: Maintains the imported employee roster and each employee's active status, territory and labor type. The Crew link records the employee's saved staffing assignment for crew management.
Schedule_Change_Log: Keeps a history of scheduling operations, including who requested the change, its outcome and any reversal. It links each operation to Add Subdivision and supports review and recovery of crew and schedule changes.
Task_Schedule: Holds the dates and status of an individual project task or scheduling stage. It links to Add Subdivision and retains the external task and milestone identities used to keep the development schedule aligned.
Workflow_Export_Lock: Tracks reservations and timing for workflow export jobs. It supports export coordination and has no direct links to business records.
